decisions.reason: The indoor air quality Bricklet uses the firm's established sensor-module, firmware and binding know-how, so it can interpret early feedback and refine the product at low cost.
As the third generation of an analog measurement module, it builds directly on accumulated knowledge and fits the firm's iterative hardware-generation strategy.
The MQTT proxy extends the firm's core API generation and binding competence to a widely used IoT protocol, strengthening the whole platform at little maintenance cost.
The CAN bus interface builds on the firm's communication-module expertise and serves automation customers, so it is worth keeping and improving despite a lower website profile.
The CO2 sensor module fits squarely within the firm's sensor-integration knowledge and the growing demand for environmental measurement.
The touch panel accessory is somewhat further from the firm's core module knowledge, but it complements existing display and prototyping kits, so it is kept while early results are assessed.
